deviations.what: Gate G1 compares V0_rep with the frozen c_score_align at |diff| > 1e-6, not exact equality.
deviations.why: per_item_T1.jsonl stores c_score_align rounded to 6 decimals; at 1e-9 every non-trivial fraction mismatched (23.8%). At 1e-6: 24/8,469 = 0.28% (the same 24 rows eval-2 reported, PYTHONHASHSEED effect), within the <= 0.5% rule.
deviations.cost: none (rounding only); every AUROC of V0 uses the frozen column.

deviations.what: Checker gate G-B is NOT_TESTABLE as a gate: the R_COMP-base PERTURB items yield 53 RENAME_SYN (YES) pairs, below the pre-registered 60 (F9).
deviations.why: only 53 R_COMP-base RENAME_SYN controls exist in dataset 3; each renames one symbol.
deviations.cost: the GG checker gate rests on G-A (balanced accuracy 0.907 on the confirm half); G-B is reported descriptively (dev 0.950, confirm 0.941).

deviations.what: The single pre-registered prompt revision was used: gloss_gg_v1 -> gloss_gg_v2 (system text only), after G-A dev (half A) scored 0.780 < 0.90.
deviations.why: v1 did not state how to treat built-in negation (NotTable(x)), argument roles, or nonce tokens (NO_NONCE 0.51, YES_FORM 0.49, NO_ROLE 0.73). prompt_revision_v2.json holds both hashes.
deviations.cost: the confirm halves were run ONCE with v2 (G-A 0.907, G-B 0.941); the dev halves were not re-scored with v2. v2 is stricter on synonyms (YES_SYN 0.80 on confirm), which raises GG's d.

deviations.what: g1 compares FA(RENAME_SYN) with the FA of the SAME controls' bases (paired); the all-bases FA is reported beside it.
deviations.why: the plan's 'FA(base refs)' is ambiguous; the paired version matches the paired-flip definition.
deviations.cost: none on the verdict (g1 passes either way: 0.932 <= 0.898 + 0.05 paired; all-base FA 0.828).

deviations.what: PRIMARY GG map search anchors shared symbol names to themselves when the full injective family exceeds the 2e4-map cap (76 E pairs, 87 PERTURB pairs; 0 cap hits after anchoring).
deviations.why: declared in prereg_gg.json before the full search; a non-identity image of a name used by BOTH formulas would need two distinct symbols of one formula to mean the same.
deviations.cost: the family is exhaustive except on those pairs.

deviations.what: GG is evaluated only on the 283 sentences with >= 1 Z row (3,490 E rows); other E rows carry predict_gg = NA.
deviations.why: plan B4 scope (pairs in sentences containing >= 1 row of Z).
deviations.cost: no GG number exists outside the development population.

deviations.what: GG_B (SECONDARY) is run only on E node pairs that PRIMARY GG does not accept, and not on PERTURB.
deviations.why: PRIMARY-accepted pairs stay accepted by construction; PERTURB g1/g2 are near-trivial because base FA is 0.83 (every metric's recall is ~1 there).
deviations.cost: GG_B has no PERTURB rename rows; it does not change the PRIMARY status in M1.

deviations.what: V5 rows whose 3-pool is empty (52 Z rows) get the exp-5 neutral value 0.6266.
deviations.why: eval-2 c_k3 convention (pool_scores: None -> neutral), pre-registered in prereg_improve.json.

deviations.what: PERTURB peers are all is_peer rows of the E sentence (exp-8 pool_rule 'all'), counted per peer ROW, as in exp 8's c_align.
deviations.why: PERTURB items have no family, so leave-own-family-out does not apply; this keeps c_gg and exp-8 c_align on identical pools.

deviations.what: The exp-1 fused FOL-Triage cascade is exposed as its layers (fol_lint, content_accounting, role_accounting) in lib/api.py, not as one fol_triage() call.
deviations.why: exp-1 fol_triage.py has no single fol_triage() function; the fused p_error lives in its pipeline.py with an LLM questionnaire. That file is vendored, but lib/api.py does not wrap it.
deviations.cost: smoke_lib.py runs fol_lint and content_accounting, not a stored p_error.

deviations.what: No new web lookups; no GPU; z3-solver 5.1.0.0 as pinned by eval-2 (the plan's text said 4.x but also said to match eval-2's matrix, which records 5.1.0).
deviations.why: matching the matrix's z3 version is what the plan requires.

deviations.what: GG_B map search: 53 pairs of one sentence were still running at the 12:08 UTC wall deadline (the freelab DFS checks its time cap only at leaves); the run was stopped by PID and those pairs are recorded as CAPPED (not agreeing, flag killed_at_wall_deadline).
deviations.why: bounded wall-clock for a SECONDARY row (F6/F8 priority 6).
deviations.cost: 53 of 11,202 GG_B pairs (0.5%) count as not agreeing.

deviations.what: GG_B gloss UNTESTED(budget): every call returned HTTP 403 'aii_run_budget_exhausted' (the run-level Test-idea OpenRouter budget of $12.00 shared by all artifacts of the run was spent: $12.10). This artifact had spent $0.219 of its own $2 cap. The pre-registered fallback checkers use the same key; the API states the limit does not reset during the run, so polling cannot help (one final /key check is logged in results/final_key_check.json).
deviations.cost: GG_B is reported as search-only brackets (c_gg lower agreement, c_ggb_allyes upper agreement); no GG_B point estimate. PRIMARY GG is unaffected (its gloss sweep completed at 11:28 UTC).
